name: North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality
mission: Providing science-based environmental stewardship for the health and prosperity of all North Carolinians.

priorities.title: Water Resources and Water Quality
priorities.description: Protect water resources, improve water quality, and reduce exposure to pathogens, toxins, nutrients, and PFAS.

priorities.title: Community Resilience and Flood Mitigation
priorities.description: Support community recovery, resilience to natural hazards and extreme weather, and flood resilience planning.

priorities.title: Waste Reduction and Land Remediation
priorities.description: Improve waste management, encourage waste reduction and recovery, and support safe redevelopment of contaminated land.

priorities.title: Environmental Infrastructure and Community Capacity
priorities.description: Strengthen reliable and resilient environmental infrastructure and support long-term viability planning for distressed local government units.

pending_priorities.title: Energy Efficiency and Clean Energy
